title: Approve the right machine and identity
when: Connecting another computer or recovering an expired device code
need: Read the four-character terminal code before hosted organization selection. Select the intended organization, compare the machine, code, expiry and signed-in identity with yoke machines pending, then approve personally using yoke machines approve CODE or refuse using yoke machines deny CODE. A code already routed elsewhere names its original organization and requires a fresh connection. Return to the terminal: pending waits until one-time delivery, denial or expiry. Lost delivery requires a fresh connection; expiry does not renew a code. A below-floor server names its minimum version and offers an explicit token or an operator upgrade.
surface: Shared approval card and machine authorization reference.
review: Engine producer contract and authorized consumer source evidence reviewed. Historical production review on 2026-10-19 proved fresh code before organization choice, personal approval, matching terminal/browser details, completed activation, authenticated use, consumed onboarding, other-organization refusal and replacement of an expired request with a fresh connection. Durable consumption matched one active machine credential. Same-organization replay, concurrent delivery, lost-delivery recovery, below-floor recovery and broader installer/visual coverage remain source-covered or unverified; this bounded result does not close the hosted handoff proof gap.
